title: HTTP, REST, and JSON Boundaries Quick Check

questions.prompt: Match each HTTP method to its usual intent.
questions.explanation: Methods communicate semantics used by clients, servers, caches, and retry logic.

questions.prompt: Which status family normally represents a server-side failure?
questions.explanation: Five-hundred codes report that the server failed to fulfil the request.

questions.prompt: A valid JSON document automatically satisfies your Kotlin domain invariants.
questions.explanation: JSON syntax says nothing about application rules such as required identifiers, valid ranges, or currency units.
